ffmpeg.trust: Official HTTPS source. Detached RSA release signature verified at intake using openpgp@6.3.0 against the official fingerprint FCF986EA15E6E293A5644F10B4322F04D67658D8 (https://ffmpeg.org/download.html), 2026-10-30. Builds enforce this authenticated archive SHA-256; signature and public key are bundled for independent verification. MacPorts independently corroborates the archive digest.

x264.trust: Official VideoLAN HTTPS Git, fixed stable commit independently corroborated by Homebrew source recipe. SHA-256 pins git archive --format=tar --prefix=x264/ of that commit; it is a locally calculated source archive digest, not an upstream signed digest.
